stopping_rules.rule: Execute exactly106 encoding cells and6 coefficient cells with all4 respective arms and controls once, serially. No outcome-based scaling or target replacement.
Encoding cap degree2/256rows/128SATcandidates/512PCcalls yields censored search without implying UNSAT; independent complete census remains separate.
Coefficient inventory checks cap83521 leaves and4913 prefixes percell protect exact scope; a cap or mismatch preserves incomplete status and cannot certify UNSAT.
Certificate, model-set, chart-union, source or input mismatch invalidates the affected comparison; retain raw cells and no silent rerun.

invalidation_rules: Source/config mismatch, missing/duplicate fixture or arm, oracle-based clause steering, false certificate, dropped squarefree exceptional chart, failed required control, or inconsistent model set.

decision_rule.text: Exact equivalence and pruning claims require every named finite check. Record phase counters and bounded-search censoring descriptively; prior-seen fixtures do not establish held-out performance. A/A semantic model sets must match, while cost/order sensitivity is reported.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact model-set equality, certificate identities, complete chart union, per-phase primitive/event integers and censor status.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Per-cell same-unit integer differences only, descriptive; no mixed-unit operation total or timing inference.

inadmissible: Prime fields only; fixed nonsingular nonanomalous prime-order curves.
No scalar recovery, cryptographic-scale ECDLP attack, intrinsic degree of regularity bound or timing claim.
Reference model sets may verify but never steer search clauses, candidate order or target selection.
No expansion of previous matrix/backdoor sweeps without a structural change.
All prior data exposure disclosed; repeated fixtures are calibration, not held-out performance evidence.
No mixed primitive-operation total; build, search, certificate checking, reconstruction, fallback and oracle work remain separate.
One serial scientific run, declared finite inventory, no outcome-dependent retries or scaling.

Common PC degree2 is an incomplete finite window: unrestricted degree4 quartics may be discarded until branch restriction. This is not a fair determination of intrinsic regularity or a complete degree-D closure.

literature.claim: Exact two-summand quadratic lift motivates equivalent finite encodings; no complexity claim.

Kosters and Yeo Proposition2.1 and first-fall versus regularity discussion, read before design; geometric summation-polynomial property does not establish rational lift or regularity. Rational two-summand non-two-torsion lift is checked separately.
Hader et al. Sections4-5, read before design: feasible-value tracking and polynomial conflict explanations motivate univariate gcd/Bezout; no Yices implementation or benchmark reproduction claimed.
